title: Nvidia’s CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid personal scandal
dek: Huang stepped down Thursday after scrutiny over two extramarital affairs; investors are still processing the news and the stock ticked up.
body:
# What happened
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned on Thursday after coming under scrutiny for two extramarital affairs. Investors have continued to weigh the news; Nvidia’s stock moved slightly higher following the announcement.

## Why it matters
A CEO departure at Nvidia matters because the company is a central supplier of AI chips and has been a major driver of recent market gains. Leadership changes at a company of this size can affect investor confidence, strategic continuity and the pace of product and partnership decisions. The circumstances of Huang’s departure , scrutiny over personal conduct — raise questions about governance and oversight at the company.

## The details
- Jensen Huang resigned as CEO on Thursday. 
- The resignation followed scrutiny over two extramarital affairs. 
- Investors continued to weigh Huang’s exit after the announcement; Nvidia’s stock inched higher.

Many specifics have not been reported. It is not yet known who will take over day-to-day leadership, whether the board has named an interim or permanent successor, or what timeline the company will follow for any leadership transition. Details about the nature of the scrutiny, any internal investigations, or company discipline beyond the resignation have not been disclosed.

## What to watch
Watch for formal announcements from Nvidia about a replacement or interim leadership and any statements from the board clarifying governance actions. Also follow subsequent market reactions and regulatory filings that could disclose more context about the resignation.

Source: [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/nvidia-nvda-stock-jensen-huang-transition.html)
